2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant forged document and sold the property of the informant to some other person.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that it is a private dispute.
It has been settled by the parties.
Charge-sheet has also been filed in the matter.
A Criminal Misc. Application No. 496 of 2023 has already been filed seeking quashing of the entire proceedings based on the charge-sheet.
This is so stated in para 11 of the affidavit, filed in support of the bail application.
5. Learned State Counsel would submit that it is a case of committing forgery.

6. It is being stated that the parties have settled the dispute and petition has already been filed,
keeping it in view, along with the nature of the offence, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail.
Accordingly, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
